name: EPIC 220260779
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.2 solar radii and 1.07 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220260779 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.243087 (16th-84th percentiles 8.863318-9.63463), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,333 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.07 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,736 K at its surface.
